title: [Đề 03] Thực Hành Kỹ Năng Trọng Tâm Bậc 3 — Tập 2 (Freshwater & Public Health)
description: Tập 2 tích hợp chuỗi bài tập thực hành Reading, Listening, Writing & Speaking trọng tâm Bậc 3: Freshwater (Part 2), The Life of Ainsley Harriott (Part 3), Smoking and Public Health (Part 4), Da Nang Holiday, Traffic Jams & Obesity (Writing).

tasks.title: Part 1: Signs & Notices
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. Choose the best answer (A, B, or C) that matches the meaning of each sign, message, or notice.

questions.prompt:
From: Sofia
To: David
Hi from Oslo! I'm having such fun skiing in the mountains. Here are some photos I took.
See you on Saturday!

options.text: Sofia is writing to tell David when she will see him.
Sofia is writing to send David some pictures.
Sofia is writing to tell David where she is going on holiday.

questions.explanationVi: Sofia viết trong email gửi David: 'Hi from Oslo! I'm having such fun skiing in the mountains. Here are some photos I took.' (Đây là một vài bức ảnh mình đã chụp). Mục đích chính của email là gửi cho David xem một số bức ảnh ('send David some pictures'). Phương án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: vui vẻ, tận hưởng niềm vui

questions.prompt:
To: Paula
From: Ian
Call me this evening after your biology class. My mobile phone isn't working, so here's my landline: 067123456.

options.text: Ian wants Paula to call him at home.
Ian wants Paula to call him on his mobile.
Ian wants Paula to call him after his biology class.

questions.explanationVi: Ian nhắn Paula: 'My mobile phone isn't working, so here's my landline: 067123456.' Vì điện thoại di động bị hỏng nên Ian đưa số điện thoại bàn cố định ở nhà ('landline') để Paula gọi cho anh ấy tại nhà ('call him at home'). Lưu ý lớp học sinh học là của Paula ('your biology class') chứ không phải của Ian (loại C). Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt:
Customers can apply to become gym members online.
Please collect ID cards from the gym.

options.text: People can get their gym ID cards online.
People can apply to become members only on the internet.
People can only apply for membership at the gym.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo của phòng tập ghi: 'Customers can apply to become gym members online. Please collect ID cards from the gym.' (Khách hàng đăng ký làm hội viên phòng tập trực tuyến trên mạng. Vui lòng nhận thẻ hội viên trực tiếp tại phòng tập). Do đó việc đăng ký hội viên được thực hiện qua mạng internet ('apply to become members only on the internet'). Phương án B đúng.

questions.prompt:
Hi George,
The new technology centre is opening this weekend. I wonder if it will have cool things. Let me know before Friday.
Kelly

What does George need to do?

options.text: visit the technology centre at the weekend
tell Kelly if the technology centre is open this weekend
tell Kelly if he can go to the technology centre this weekend

questions.explanationVi: Kelly rủ George đi thăm trung tâm công nghệ mới mở vào cuối tuần này và dặn: 'Let me know before Friday' (Báo cho mình biết trước thứ Sáu nhé). Như vậy George cần báo cho Kelly biết liệu cậu ấy có thể đi tới trung tâm công nghệ vào cuối tuần này hay không. Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt:
Sports store
All trainers half price!
New season football kit in!
New sports equipment!

options.text: You pay less for all clothes at the store.
You can only buy trainers at the store.
You can find clothes for different seasons at the store.

questions.explanationVi: Quảng cáo cửa hàng thể thao ghi: 'All trainers half price! New season football kit in! New sports equipment!' Chỉ có giày thể thao ('trainers') được giảm nửa giá chứ không phải toàn bộ quần áo (loại A), và cửa hàng còn bán trang phục bóng đá theo mùa mới cùng dụng cụ thể thao (loại B, chọn C). Phương án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: bộ trang phục thi đấu bóng đá

questions.prompt:
Weekly meeting
Change of day and time: Tuesday, not Monday.
Be there at 9.30 a.m.!

options.text: The meeting is on Monday at 9.30 a.m.
The meeting doesn't usually start at 9.30 a.m.
There is a meeting every Tuesday morning.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo ghi: 'Change of day and time: Tuesday, not Monday. Be there at 9.30 a.m.!' (Thay đổi cả ngày VÀ giờ họp: chuyển sang thứ Ba thay vì thứ Hai, có mặt lúc 9.30 sáng). Vì 9.30 sáng là giờ họp mới sau khi đã thay đổi ('Change of day and time'), nên thông thường cuộc họp không bắt đầu lúc 9.30 sáng. Phương án B đúng.

questions.prompt:
PARKING
2 hours maximum
£4 per hour
The value of a parking penalty charge notice is £50

options.text: It costs at least £50 to park here for two hours.
There are no parking charges after 2.00 p.m.
You have to pay a fine if you park here for three hours.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo đỗ xe quy định thời gian đỗ tối đa là 2 giờ ('2 hours maximum') và tiền phạt vi phạm là £50 ('parking penalty charge notice is £50'). Do đó nếu đỗ xe ở đây 3 giờ (vượt quá mức tối đa 2 giờ), bạn sẽ phải nộp tiền phạt ('pay a fine'). Phương án C đúng.

tasks.title: Part 2: Freshwater
tasks.instructions: Read the text below about freshwater on Earth and choose the correct word (A, B, or C) for each space from 8 to 15.

passage.title: Freshwater
passage.text:
Although water covers about 70 percent of the Earth's surface, almost all of it is salt water in the oceans. Only about 2.5 percent of the world's water is freshwater, and most of that is frozen (8) ________ ice caps and glaciers. As a result, less than 1 percent of all water on Earth is easily available (9) ________ human use.

People depend on freshwater from rivers, lakes, and underground sources for drinking, cooking, and washing. However, agriculture uses the (10) ________ amount of freshwater—about 70 percent worldwide—to grow food for our growing population. Factories also need large quantities of water to (11) ________ goods and generate electricity.

Today, many regions are facing serious water shortages (12) ________ climate change and pollution. When untreated waste from factories and farms flows into rivers, the water becomes (13) ________ to drink. Scientists warn that if we do not protect our water resources, billions of people could (14) ________ from water scarcity in the near future. Saving water at home and reducing pollution are simple ways everyone can help (15) ________ this precious resource.

questions.prompt: Only about 2.5 percent of the world's water is freshwater, and most of that is frozen (8) ________ ice caps and glaciers.
questions.explanationVi: Bài tập thực hành Reading Part 2 trong sách Chuẩn Bậc 3: 'frozen in ice caps and glaciers' (đóng băng bên trong các chỏm băng và sông băng).

questions.prompt: As a result, less than 1 percent of all water on Earth is easily available (9) ________ human use.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'available for something' (có sẵn để phục vụ mục đích gì). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: có sẵn cho mục đích sử dụng

questions.prompt: However, agriculture uses the (10) ________ amount of freshwater—about 70 percent worldwide...
questions.explanationVi: Sau mạo từ 'the' dùng so sánh nhất: 'the largest amount of freshwater' (lượng nước ngọt lớn nhất). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: Factories also need large quantities of water to (11) ________ goods and generate electricity.
questions.explanationVi: 'produce goods' (sản xuất hàng hóa). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: Today, many regions are facing serious water shortages (12) ________ climate change and pollution.
questions.explanationVi: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ 'climate change and pollution' nên dùng 'because of'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: When untreated waste from factories and farms flows into rivers, the water becomes (13) ________ to drink.
questions.explanationVi: 'unsafe to drink' (không an toàn để uống). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: chất thải chưa qua xử lý

questions.prompt: Scientists warn that if we do not protect our water resources, billions of people could (14) ________ from water scarcity in the near future.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'suffer from something' (chịu đựng / hứng chịu tình trạng khan hiếm nước). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: Saving water at home and reducing pollution are simple ways everyone can help (15) ________ this precious resource.
questions.explanationVi: 'preserve this precious resource' (bảo tồn nguồn tài nguyên quý giá này). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

tasks.title: Part 3: The Life of Ainsley Harriott
tasks.instructions: Read the text about television chef Ainsley Harriott and decide whether statements 16 to 20 are True (A) or False (B).

passage.title: The Life of Ainsley Harriott
passage.text:
I have always been a bit of an entertainer and played the funny man. I was a part-time comedian for years, so I learned how to stand in front of an audience and make people laugh. That experience made it much easier for me when I started hosting cooking programmes on television.

My love of cooking came from my mother, Peppy. Our kitchen in London was always full of wonderful smells, and she taught me that cooking should be fun and shared with the people you love. Even though I trained at Westminster Hotel School and worked in top London restaurants, I still prefer simple, fresh home cooking.

Nowadays, when I am not filming TV shows or writing recipe books, I enjoy spending quiet weekends at home. I love working in my garden and growing my own herbs and vegetables. Many people think celebrity chefs eat at expensive restaurants every night, but my favorite meal is still a simple roast chicken dinner cooked at home with my family.

questions.prompt: Ainsley Harriott felt nervous in front of audiences when he first started working on television.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 1 viết: việc từng làm diễn viên hài bán thời gian nhiều năm giúp ông quen đứng trước đám đông và thấy dễ dàng hơn nhiều khi dẫn chương trình truyền hình ('made it much easier for me when I started hosting cooking programmes'). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: Ainsley's mother inspired his passion for cooking when he was growing up.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 viết: 'My love of cooking came from my mother, Peppy'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: Ainsley received formal training at a hotel school before becoming a TV chef.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 viết: 'I trained at Westminster Hotel School and worked in top London restaurants'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: In his free time, Ainsley prefers eating at luxury restaurants every night rather than cooking at home.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 viết: 'my favorite meal is still a simple roast chicken dinner cooked at home with my family'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: Ainsley enjoys gardening and growing his own herbs and vegetables on weekends.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 viết: 'I love working in my garden and growing my own herbs and vegetables'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

tasks.title: Part 4: Smoking & Public Health
tasks.instructions: Read the passage about smoking and public health and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for questions 21 to 25.

passage.title: Smoking and Public Health
passage.text:
Every year, tobacco use causes more than eight million deaths worldwide. Cigarettes contain thousands of harmful chemicals, including nicotine, which makes smoking highly addictive. Medical research has proven that smoking is a major cause of lung cancer, heart disease, and serious breathing problems.

However, smokers are not the only ones at risk. Over one million people die each year from 'second-hand smoke'—breathing in tobacco smoke from other people in homes, restaurants, or offices. Children exposed to second-hand smoke suffer from higher rates of asthma and ear infections.

To protect public health, many governments have introduced strict laws against smoking. Smoking is now banned in indoor public places, on public transport, and near schools and hospitals. In addition, heavy taxes on cigarettes and graphic health warnings on cigarette packets have helped millions of people quit smoking and discouraged young people from starting the habit.

questions.prompt: Why is it difficult for smokers to stop smoking according to paragraph 1?

options.text: Because cigarettes contain nicotine, an addictive substance.
Because cigarettes are sold cheaply in every supermarket.
Because doctors do not warn people about lung cancer.

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ: 'Cigarettes contain thousands of harmful chemicals, including nicotine, which makes smoking highly addictive'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: What does 'second-hand smoke' in paragraph 2 mean?

options.text: Buying cheap cigarettes from a friend
Breathing in smoke from other people's cigarettes
Smoking two cigarettes at the same time

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 định nghĩa rõ: ''second-hand smoke'—breathing in tobacco smoke from other people in homes, restaurants, or offices' (hút thuốc thụ động). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: Who is particularly affected by asthma due to second-hand smoke?
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 viết: 'Children exposed to second-hand smoke suffer from higher rates of asthma and ear infections'. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: Which measure is NOT mentioned in paragraph 3 as a way governments reduce smoking?

options.text: Banning smoking in indoor public places
Putting health warnings on cigarette packets

questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 3 nêu việc cấm hút thuốc nơi công cộng trong nhà (A), đánh thuế cao và in cảnh báo sức khỏe lên vỏ bao thuốc (B), nhưng KHÔNG nói đến việc đóng cửa ngay lập tức mọi nông trại trồng thuốc lá (C). Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the passage?

options.text: To describe how tobacco is grown in different countries
To highlight the dangers of smoking and actions taken to reduce it
To compare the prices of cigarettes around the world

questions.explanationVi: Mục đích chính của bài là nêu bật tác hại của thuốc lá (với người hút và người hút thụ động) cùng các biện pháp kiểm soát thuốc lá. Đáp án chính thức sách Chuẩn Bậc 3.

tasks.title: Part 1: Short Recordings
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. For each question, you will listen to a short recording TWICE and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
tasks.transcript:
1. How did the film end?
Man: … and in this film a young man and his girlfriend try to rob a bank so they can afford to get married and go round the world together. But he gets caught outside the bank, and their dream never comes true.

2. What time does the train to Rome leave?
Man: Excuse me – what time does this train leave?
Woman: This train leaves for Paris at five to three.
Man: Paris? Isn't it the Rome train?
Woman: No – that goes at twenty-five past three from platform four.

3. What is broken?
Man: I'm terribly sorry, Mum – I've just broken something.
Woman: Oh dear – what was it?
Man: Well, I got up too quickly from the table to answer the phone and knocked one of your plates on to the floor – at least it wasn't your new lamp!
Woman: Ah – I thought I heard a crash.

4. Where are the man's shoes?
Man: Have you seen my old shoes? I thought they were under the chair by the television.
Woman: Not any more! They're by the door with the other rubbish. I've been tidying the flat.
Man: Well, the living room looks very nice … but you're not throwing my old shoes away, all the same.

5. What will Paul get at the shop?
Woman: … Right, now what do we need for this sauce so Paul can get it for me … let me see … onions, tomatoes, one red pepper, mushrooms and two carrots … so what have I got … onions … I've always got those … tomatoes … yes … red pepper … no, I'll need one of those … I've got mushrooms … oh dear … no carrots … Paul, could you go to the shop for me please?

6. How were they told to do their homework?
Boy: Wow, your homework looks great!
Girl: Thanks … I typed it on my Dad's computer.
Boy: But didn't Mrs Smith tell us we had to write it in our books?
Girl: Oh no, you're right! … Oh, what am I going to do now?

7. What did Helen buy?
Woman: Look, Roger – I've been shopping. They've got some great things in StyleRight.
Man: Hey! That's brilliant. Lovely colours and it'll keep you warm in the winter.
Woman: Yes – but are the sleeves too short for me?
Man: No – they look fine.

questions.prompt: How did the film end?

options.text: The couple get married and travel around the world.
The young man gets caught outside the bank.
They escape with the money from the bank.

questions.explanationVi: Người đàn ông kể về cái kết của bộ phim: 'But he gets caught outside the bank, and their dream never comes true.' (Nhưng chàng trai bị bắt ngay bên ngoài ngân hàng, và giấc mơ của họ không bao giờ thành hiện thực). Phương án B đúng.

questions.prompt: What time does the train to Rome leave?
questions.explanationVi: Người phụ nữ trả lời về chuyến tàu đi Rome: 'No – that goes at twenty-five past three from platform four.' (Chuyến tàu đi Paris khởi hành lúc 3 giờ kém 5, còn tàu đi Rome khởi hành lúc 3 giờ 25 phút — 'twenty-five past three'). Phương án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: ba giờ hai mươi lăm phút (3:25)

questions.prompt: What is broken?
questions.explanationVi: Người con giải thích với mẹ: 'Well, I got up too quickly from the table to answer the phone and knocked one of your plates on to the floor – at least it wasn't your new lamp!' Anh ấy đứng dậy nghe điện thoại quá vội nên làm rơi vỡ một chiếc đĩa ('one of your plates'). Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt: Where are the man's shoes?

options.text: Under the chair by the television
By the door with the rubbish

questions.explanationVi: Khi người đàn ông hỏi đôi giày cũ có còn ở dưới ghế cạnh tivi không, người phụ nữ đáp: 'Not any more! They're by the door with the other rubbish. I've been tidying the flat.' (Chúng đang ở cạnh cửa ra vào cùng với đống rác). Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt: What will Paul get at the shop?

options.text: A red pepper and two carrots

questions.explanationVi: Người phụ nữ kiểm tra nguyên liệu làm nước sốt: đã có hành tây ('onions'), cà chua ('tomatoes') và nấm ('mushrooms'), chỉ thiếu 1 quả ớt chuông đỏ và 2 củ cà rốt ('red pepper … no, I'll need one of those … oh dear … no carrots'). Do đó Paul sẽ đi mua ớt chuông đỏ và cà rốt. Phương án C đúng.

questions.prompt: How were they told to do their homework?
questions.explanationVi: Cậu bé nhắc bạn: 'But didn't Mrs Smith tell us we had to write it in our books?' và cô bé nhận ra mình đã làm sai khi đánh máy trên máy tính ('Oh no, you're right!'). Giáo viên yêu cầu viết bài tập vào vở ('write it in our books'). Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt: What did Helen buy?

options.text: A warm sweater with long sleeves

questions.explanationVi: Roger khen món đồ Helen mới mua: 'Lovely colours and it'll keep you warm in the winter.' và Helen hỏi: 'Yes – but are the sleeves too short for me?' Món đồ giữ ấm mùa đông và có tay áo dài ('sleeves') là chiếc áo len/áo ấm dài tay. Phương án B đúng.

tasks.title: Part 2: Short Conversations
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. You will listen to six short conversations TWICE and choose the right answer (A, B, or C) for questions 8 to 14.
tasks.transcript:
8. You will hear two friends talking about a trip to the theatre.
Man: So, are you ready for the theatre this evening? I can't wait.
Woman: Yes, I'm really excited too. It's been a while since I went to the theatre. Don't forget your student ID, will you? They always ask to see it before they give you the student discount.
Man: OK. I'll remind the others in case they forget. I'll text them in a minute.
Woman: And it's only offered to full-time students, remember. Some of our friends are only part time.
Man: OK, it's only Tahira who is full time so I'll let her know.

9. You will hear two friends talking about the man's job.
Man: I'm going to that employment event in town tomorrow.
Woman: Really? Are you looking for a new job? I always thought you enjoyed it where you work.
Man: Well, I'm thinking of having a change of career. I've been working as an accountant for years now and I feel like doing something different. I've got a few friends who are teachers and they think I'd enjoy doing something like that. It would mean a lower salary but that's OK. So, I'm just going to find out about the qualifications I need.

10. You will hear a husband and wife talking about breakfast.
Man: OK, my turn to make breakfast, I think. What would you like?
Woman: I'd love a bowl of cereal, but the last time I looked in the cupboard we'd run out. Did you get any when you went shopping?
Man: No, I forgot to put that on the list. Sorry. How about some ham and cheese?
Woman: Yes, that would be nice. We could use some of that nice bread you bought. And can I have coffee for a change instead of tea?
Man: OK. Oh, I'm feeling quite hungry now!

11. You will hear two friends talking about buying a bed.
Man: I need to get a new bed for my flat. Is there anywhere you can recommend?
Woman: The furniture store in town has some and they're good quality.
Man: Really? I might go there later. I was thinking of looking online but it's difficult to tell how comfortable they'd be if you can't try them out first.
Woman: Well, you might find a bargain that way. You could try one out in the shop and then order the same one online if you find one that costs less than the shop.
Man: Good idea. I might do that.

12. You will hear two friends talking about going for a walk.
Woman: I feel like getting outside in the country today and having a fast walk. Do you fancy joining me?
Man: I'm not sure. We might need to take our umbrellas. The weather forecast says there's going to be heavy rain.
Woman: I know I've just checked. But it's not expected until later this afternoon so I'll just take my jacket. Anyway, a bit of rain won't hurt you. And the fresh air will be good for us.
Man: Yes, I suppose so. And I've got nothing to do today so let's go now, shall we?

13 & 14. You will hear two friends talking about a passport photograph.
Woman: I need to get a new passport before we go on holiday. Where can I get my photograph taken?
Man: There's a machine in the pharmacy round the corner but I think it's out of order. I saw someone asking one of the shop assistants for help last week.
Woman: That's a pity. I might have to go into town.
Man: There are a lot of places in town. I know you can get it done in the post office. That one probably works OK, and if you want one that's open in the evening you could try the machine at the train station.

questions.prompt: You will hear two friends talking about a trip to the theatre. What does the woman say about it?

options.text: The theatre offers cheaper entry to some students.
It's not always necessary to show student ID.

questions.explanationVi: Người phụ nữ nhắc bạn mang thẻ sinh viên để được giảm giá và nói rõ: 'And it's only offered to full-time students, remember. Some of our friends are only part time.' Như vậy nhà hát chỉ giảm giá vé cho một số đối tượng sinh viên (sinh viên hệ chính quy toàn thời gian). Phương án A đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: ưu đãi giảm giá dành cho sinh viên

questions.prompt: You will hear two friends talking about the man's job. The man

options.text: is looking for work as an accountant.
is prepared to earn less money.

questions.explanationVi: Người đàn ông đã làm kế toán nhiều năm và muốn chuyển sang làm giáo viên: 'It would mean a lower salary but that's OK.' (Công việc đó đồng nghĩa với mức lương thấp hơn nhưng không sao cả). Điều này có nghĩa anh ấy sẵn sàng chấp nhận kiếm ít tiền hơn ('prepared to earn less money'). Phương án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: bằng cấp, chứng chỉ chuyên môn

questions.prompt: You will hear a husband and wife talking about breakfast. What does the wife say?

options.text: She would like to have the same drink as usual.

questions.explanationVi: Người vợ nói: 'I'd love a bowl of cereal, but the last time I looked in the cupboard we'd run out.' và người chồng xác nhận đã quên mua ngũ cốc. Cụm 'we'd run out' đồng nghĩa với 'There isn't any cereal left' (Đã hết sạch ngũ cốc). Phương án A đúng.

questions.prompt: You will hear two friends talking about buying a bed. The woman thinks the ones online

options.text: cost less in the furniture store.

questions.explanationVi: Khi người đàn ông nhắc đến việc tìm mua giường trực tuyến (online), người phụ nữ nói: 'Well, you might find a bargain that way. You could try one out in the shop and then order the same one online if you find one that costs less than the shop.' Cụm 'find a bargain' và 'costs less' đồng nghĩa với 'might be cheaper' (có thể rẻ hơn). Phương án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: dùng thử, nằm thử trước khi mua

questions.prompt: You will hear two friends talking about going for a walk. What do they both agree about?

options.text: The need to take an umbrella.
The walk will be a healthy thing to do.
They need to check the weather forecast.

questions.explanationVi: Người phụ nữ nói: 'And the fresh air will be good for us.' (Không khí trong lành sẽ rất tốt cho sức khỏe của chúng ta) và người đàn ông đồng tình: 'Yes, I suppose so... let's go now, shall we?'. Cả hai cùng đồng ý rằng chuyến đi bộ sẽ rất tốt cho sức khỏe. Phương án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: thích, hào hứng muốn làm gì

questions.prompt: You will hear two friends talking about a passport photograph. What does the man say?

options.text: The shop assistants are really helpful.
The post office is open in the evening.

questions.explanationVi: Người đàn ông nói: 'There's a machine in the pharmacy round the corner but I think it's out of order.' Máy chụp ảnh ở hiệu thuốc ngay góc phố gần nhất bị hỏng ('out of order' = 'doesn't work'). Phương án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: bị hỏng, ngưng hoạt động (máy móc)
ngay ở góc phố gần đây

questions.prompt: In the final conversation, where does the man suggest going if the woman wants to take her passport photo in the evening?

options.text: To the pharmacy round the corner
To the post office in town

questions.explanationVi: Ở câu cuối của đoạn hội thoại số 13, người đàn ông gợi ý: '...and if you want one that's open in the evening you could try the machine at the train station.' Nếu muốn chụp ảnh vào buổi tối thì cô ấy có thể ra máy chụp tự động ở nhà ga tàu hỏa ('at the train station'). Phương án C đúng.

tasks.title: Part 3: Longer Conversation (True / False)
tasks.instructions: You will hear a conversation between Matthew and his mother. Listen TWICE and decide if each sentence from 15 to 20 is Correct (True) or Incorrect (False). Choose A for True and B for False.
tasks.transcript:
Matthew: … Bye, Mum, see you later.
Mother: How are you getting to college? It's already five to nine. You've missed the bus. Are you going to walk?
Matthew: No, I'm borrowing your car, remember?
Mother: Oh Matthew, I need it today. If you want to borrow the car you need to ask me several days before. Sorry, you're going to have to walk. It just isn't convenient today.
Matthew: But I did ask you. We talked about it last week. Don't you remember? I've promised to help Alan move all his books and things after my lecture today. He's moving to a new flat and his car's broken down. I've got to help him move his things – he can't stay in the old flat after today. I promised him.
Mother: All right, all right. Of course, you must keep your promise. I remember now, you did tell me, but I thought you said next Wednesday. You said the 9th and that's next week when I'm in Birmingham for a meeting so I shan't need the car.
Matthew: I didn't ask for it next Wednesday! I've got an exam next Wednesday! I can't help Alan when I'm doing an exam, can I?
Mother: No, I suppose not. Well, I expect you're right. I didn't write it down so it's my fault. Next time we must both write it down, and make sure we write down the same date!
Matthew: OK. So can I have it today? I need to go or I'll miss my lecture.
Mother: Well, what am I supposed to do? I need to be at work in half an hour.
Matthew: I'll give you a lift there on my way to college. How about that?
Mother: I suppose I haven't got much choice. Come on, then.

questions.prompt: Matthew had intended to catch the bus this morning.
questions.explanationVi: Khi mẹ nói Matthew đã lỡ xe buýt ('You've missed the bus. Are you going to walk?'), Matthew trả lời: 'No, I'm borrowing your car, remember?' Cậu ấy vốn định mượn xe ô tô của mẹ chứ không hề có ý định bắt xe buýt sáng nay. Nhận định là SAI (False). Đáp án B.

questions.prompt: Matthew thought his mother knew he wanted the car this morning.
questions.explanationVi: Matthew nói: 'No, I'm borrowing your car, remember?... But I did ask you. We talked about it last week. Don't you remember?' Matthew đinh ninh rằng mẹ đã biết việc cậu muốn mượn xe vào sáng hôm nay. Nhận định là ĐÚNG (True). Đáp án A.

questions.prompt: Matthew is going to help Alan to repair his car.
questions.explanationVi: Matthew giải thích: 'I've promised to help Alan move all his books and things after my lecture today. He's moving to a new flat and his car's broken down.' Xe của Alan bị hỏng nên Matthew mượn xe mẹ để giúp Alan chuyển sách vở và đồ đạc sang căn hộ mới, chứ không phải giúp sửa xe. Nhận định là SAI (False). Đáp án B.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: bị hỏng máy giữa đường (xe cộ)

questions.prompt: Matthew needs the car next Wednesday.
questions.explanationVi: Matthew khẳng định: 'I didn't ask for it next Wednesday! I've got an exam next Wednesday!' Cậu ấy cần xe ngay hôm nay chứ không phải thứ Tư tuần sau. Nhận định là SAI (False). Đáp án B.

questions.prompt: Matthew's mother agrees she made a mistake.
questions.explanationVi: Mẹ của Matthew thừa nhận: 'Well, I expect you're right. I didn't write it down so it's my fault.' ('it's my fault' = đó là lỗi của mẹ vì đã không ghi chép lại). Nhận định là ĐÚNG (True). Đáp án A.

questions.prompt: Matthew has the car in the end.
questions.explanationVi: Matthew đề nghị lái xe chở mẹ tới chỗ làm trên đường cậu đi học ('I'll give you a lift there on my way to college') và mẹ đồng ý giao xe cho cậu ('I suppose I haven't got much choice. Come on, then.'). Như vậy cuối cùng Matthew được lấy xe đi. Nhận định là ĐÚNG (True). Đáp án A.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: cho ai đi nhờ xe, chở ai đến nơi nào

tasks.title: Task 1: A Wonderful Holiday Experience in Da Nang
tasks.instructions: Write a paragraph of at least 80 words about a wonderful holiday experience in Da Nang. Use all the information in the box.

writingPrompts.title: A Wonderful Holiday Experience in Da Nang
writingPrompts.instructions: Write a paragraph of at least 80 words about a wonderful holiday experience in Da Nang using the prompts below.

dataCard.Destination & Time: Da Nang City — Last summer holiday (4 days, 3 nights)
dataCard.Activities: Swam at My Khe Beach, visited Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge, tasted local seafood

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: Last summer, I had a wonderful four-day holiday in Da Nang City with my close university friends after finishing our final exams. On the first day, we checked into a small hotel near the coast and spent the afternoon swimming in the clear blue water at My Khe Beach. On the second day, we took a cable car up to Ba Na Hills, walked across the famous Golden Bridge, and took lots of photos together. In the evenings, we walked along the Han River and enjoyed delicious local seafood at reasonable prices. This trip was an unforgettable experience that helped us relax and strengthened our friendship.

tasks.title: Task 2: Opinion Paragraph (Choice)
tasks.instructions: Choose ONE of the two topics below and write a paragraph of at least 100 words. State your main points clearly and support them with reasons and examples.

writingPrompts.title: Choose Topic 2.1 or Topic 2.2
writingPrompts.instructions: Choose ONE topic and write a paragraph of at least 100 words.

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph of at least 100 words about the causes of traffic jams in big cities.
guidelines: Rapid population growth and too many private motorbikes and cars
Narrow roads and poor traffic infrastructure during rush hours
Low awareness of traffic rules among some drivers

topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph of at least 100 words about the problems of obesity among young people.
guidelines: Increases the risk of serious illnesses such as diabetes and heart disease
Reduces physical fitness and makes young people feel tired easily
Causes low self-confidence and stress in school and social life

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: Traffic congestion in big cities is caused by several major factors in modern life. Firstly, the rapid growth of urban population has led to a huge increase in private vehicles, especially motorbikes and cars, travelling on the streets at the same time during rush hours. Secondly, the road system in many city centers is still narrow and outdated, while public transport such as buses and metro lines has not yet met people's daily travel needs. Finally, some commuters do not obey traffic lights and lane rules, which easily causes accidents and long delays. Understanding these causes is necessary so cities can improve public transport and reduce traffic jams.

tasks.title: Part 1: Social Interaction (3 minutes)
tasks.instructions: In this part, the examiner will ask you 5 questions about yourself and familiar everyday topics. Answer naturally in 2 to 3 sentences per question.

speakingPrompts.title: Social Interaction — School, Leisure & Daily Habits
speakingPrompts.instructions: Answer the following questions clearly and naturally.
questions: What's your favorite subject at school, and why?
What do you usually do after school or work?
Do you prefer eating at home with your family or eating out?
Do you prefer shopping in small local shops or big supermarkets?
How do you stay healthy in your daily life?

tasks.title: Part 2: Cue-Based Description (5 minutes)
tasks.instructions: Choose ONE of the two given cards. You have 1 minute to prepare your ideas, 1.5 to 2 minutes to speak, and then answer two follow-up questions.

speakingPrompts.title: Cue Card Choice — School Events & Study Habits
speakingPrompts.instructions: Select Card 1 or Card 2 and talk about all the points on the card.

cueCards.title: Describe a school event you enjoyed (such as Sports Day).
prompts: What the event was and when it happened
What activities took place during the event
Who you joined the event with
And explain why it was special and how you felt
furtherQuestions: Why are extracurricular events important for students?
How do team sports help students build stronger friendships?
cueCards.sampleResponse: I would like to talk about our school's Sports Day 2024, which took place on March 10th in our school stadium. During the event, there were many exciting competitions such as a 100-metre running race, tug of war, and fun team games. I joined the tug-of-war team with my classmates and cheered loudly for our class runners. This event was very special to me because our class won the second prize after practicing together for two weeks. I felt extremely excited, proud, and happy to share such unforgettable memories with my friends.

cueCards.title: Describe a good habit that helps you concentrate on your work or study.
prompts: How you started it and how it helps you
And explain why you think it is helpful
furtherQuestions: Why is it more difficult for young people to concentrate nowadays than in the past?
Do you think smartphones harm students' ability to focus?
cueCards.sampleResponse: One good habit that really helps me concentrate on my studies is listening to soft instrumental piano music while putting my phone in another room. I started this habit last year when I was preparing for my university exams. It blocks out noisy traffic from the street and stops me from checking social media messages. I think this habit is simple, free, and very effective because it keeps my mind calm and allows me to focus deeply for two hours without feeling tired.
